# GitHub Actions workflows

## Documented workflows

These pages describe the checked-in GitHub Actions workflow definitions in this directory. They reflect repository source; external action implementations and GitHub-side settings are not included. Updatecli configuration under [`updatecli.d`](updatecli.d/README.md) is not a GitHub Actions workflow.
